area: Printer Friendly Work Orders - Print Layout Line Items
title: Each line shows number, description, status, time, story and techs
permissions_required: View Work Order (no new permission introduced)
preconditions: In the top menu click “Work Orders”, open a work order to reach its detail view, click “More” (the overflow/actions menu on the work order toolbar) and choose “Print Work Order” — the browser print view/dialog opens. (Route drafted from the spec and marked PROVISIONAL — confirm on the build.)
The open work order has at least one line item on its Lines tab.
steps: On the Print Work Order view (see Preconditions), read a line item on the printout.
expected:
1. Each line item displays: line number; line description (name); line status; actual time / estimated time; tech story (if one exists); and assigned technician(s) (if assigned).

---
This is the expected behaviour as per epic SV-9383 and story SV-9386 (Story 3, Print Layout - Line Items) and the Printer Friendly Work Orders specification version 8, section S3-R1, read on 25 August 2026.
